policy.clone_savings: Ignored build artifacts are not in Git. Cleanup never changes clone size unless a tracked fingerprint is deleted, which this tool refuses.

retained_release.rebuild_note: Do not overwrite build/act1/rr.dmg. That path is the frozen P4-013 / P4-044 SHA bind. New act1 membership proofs use a side path such as build/inventory/act1-after.pck.

allowlisted_removable.reason: Regenerable current rr preset export. CI and SETUP rebuild it.
Unpacked leftover from the rr export or DMG extract. Regenerable from build/rr.dmg.
Local QA logs. Regenerable by rerunning the named test or validator.
Side-path PCK proofs. Never a substitute for the frozen act1 DMG.
Ignored host-specific benchmark JSON. Regenerable via tools/run_performance_report.sh and tools/benchmarks/.
Local preview captures. Not tracked documentation evidence.
Regenerable rr-diagnostic export path from export_presets.cfg.
Local performance probe JSON at build root.
Local build-root preview PNGs. Documentation evidence lives under docs/reports/images/.
Accidental Godot import sidecars for local build-root PNGs.
Local composition/ownership probe JSON at build root.

rr.command: mkdir -p build && godot --headless --export-release "rr" ./build/rr.dmg && test -s ./build/rr.dmg && python3 tools/verify_shipped_resources.py --dmg ./build/rr.dmg --preset rr
rr.notes: Current slice/demo export. Regenerable. Not the P4-044 bind.

act1_side_path.command: mkdir -p build/inventory && godot --headless --export-pack "act1" ./build/inventory/act1-after.pck && python3 tools/verify_shipped_resources.py --pck ./build/inventory/act1-after.pck --preset act1
act1_side_path.notes: Never write a new act1 export over build/act1/rr.dmg.
